instruction: Use terminal commands to launch GIMP, open "cola.png", rotate it 90 degrees clockwise, and save the rotated image as "rotated.png" for the banner.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires rotating the cola.png image 90 degrees clockwise. After rotation, the dimensions swap: original 1233x1280 becomes 1280x1233. Verified by calculation: width and height swap places after 90-degree rotation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both dimension swap (1233x1280 -> 1280x1233) and rotation direction
Corner pixel mapping verification correctly implements 90° clockwise rotation logic: orig_tl->rot_tr, orig_tr->rot_br, orig_br->rot_bl, orig_bl->rot_tl
Evaluator can distinguish between 90° clockwise vs counterclockwise rotation (different corner mappings)
Evaluator can reject arbitrary images with matching dimensions (corner pixels won't match)
Robust fallback behavior: if original URL unavailable, falls back to dimension-only check with warning
Pixel similarity threshold of 0.7 (70%) is reasonable for rotation verification accounting for compression artifacts
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider making similarity threshold configurable via options parameter for different image types
Minor: Could add more detailed logging of individual corner similarities for debugging failed cases
